title: When the Inventory Turns
author: Isandro Ishikawa
blurb: Felix Kavanagh, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
